Description

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name

Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_16 - Reserved

Bytes 2-3 are padding introduced by the DWORD-aligned RDL view and are not part of the OCP command payload.

VENDOR_SPECIFIC_STATUS - Vendor specific status

Byte 1 reports vendor-specific recovery status. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 RECOVERY_STATUS.

REC_IMG_INDEX - Recovery image index

Byte 0 bits 7:4 report the recovery image index. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 RECOVERY_STATUS.

DEV_REC_STATUS - Device recovery status

Byte 0 bits 3:0 report recovery status. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 RECOVERY_STATUS.
